questionText:
Match List I (Direction of Aggression in P-F Study) with List II (Operational Description):

List I:
(A) Extrapunitive
(B) Intropunitive
(C) Impunitive
(D) Obstacle-Dominance

List II:
(I) Aggression is turned inward upon oneself, expressing personal guilt or apology
(II) Aggression is directed outward, blaming another person or external object
(III) The frustrating barrier itself stands out and is continually highlighted
(IV) Aggression is avoided, glossed over, or dismissed to maintain harmony

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-II, B-I, C-IV, D-III
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.

options.text: A-I, B-II, C-IV, D-III
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: A-II, B-IV, C-III, D-I
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Extrapunitive: blaming external world (A-II); Intropunitive: blaming oneself (B-I); Impunitive: glossing over frustration (C-IV); Obstacle-dominance: barrier highlighted (D-III).
Hence, Option D is correct.
Hence, option (A) is the correct match.

questionText:
Match List I (Sheldon's Somatotype) with List II (Associated Physical and Temperament Characteristics):

List I:
(A) Endomorphic
(B) Mesomorphic
(C) Ectomorphic
(D) Cerebrotonic

List II:
(I) Muscular, strong body build; adventurous, assertive, bold temperament
(II) Thin, long body build; sensitive, intellectual, artistic temperament
(III) Round, soft body build; relaxed, sociable, fond of food temperament
(IV) Mental and nervous temperament associated with ectomorphic physique

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-III, B-II, C-IV, D-I

detailedSolution:

According to NCERT principles for Self and Personality (Major Approaches to Personality):
A-III, B-I, C-II, D-IV

Detailed Analysis:
Endomorphic is round/soft/sociable (A-III); Mesomorphic is muscular/assertive (B-I); Ectomorphic is thin/delicate (C-II); Cerebrotonic represents ectomorphic temperament (D-IV).
Hence, Option D is correct.

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.
